description:
Compare one endpoint across multiple zones.

`start`/`end` default to UTC; `start` inclusive, `end` EXCLUSIVE.
`tz="local"` is rejected (zones may differ); pass an explicit IANA
tz like "Europe/Berlin" if you need wall-clock alignment.
`filters={column: [values]}` keeps only rows whose categorical column
holds one of the values, in every zone (see get_series); zones whose
periods hold several rows are listed under `split_periods_by_zone`.
name: compare_zones
title: Compare zones
